obliqueFindings: The curved facade, room side walls, roof levels, rooftop tanks and sheds remain coherent from the oblique camera; this is still a complete 3D environment.
Rectangular and arched openings retain their recess and wall thickness from the side.
The steelwork has an overly broad wood-like surface, some foliage is poorly attached, the water is excessively reflective, and pipes do not yet run continuously across all bays.
frontFindings: The upper arcade now continues across the left and central bays at a much more consistent image height.
The inherited triple courtyard scale has been removed; the physical ring remains complete and the water contact is closer to the observed height.
The initially inherited triple tree instance scale was corrected before this final front render.
The distant night hill was lowered continuously with its vegetation, while the first 12 units of ground remain unchanged. The sky is visible again through the opening.
The door silhouette and shoe projections improve in the aggregate, but left hand, waist and right hem landmarks regress under the new camera. Their three-dimensional pose still needs refinement.
Steel members remain misplaced, the foundation is too bulky, the night clouds look like horizontal bands, and reflective water still dominates the image differently from the reference.
remaining: 按新镜头重新校准残存钢架的立柱、拱肋与折断位置，目前有横梁穿过参照中应为空的背景区域。
连续管道、临水台基、门基砖石和铺石形状仍与电影参照不同。
门内远景虽已重新露出天空，但云层仍呈明显横带，需按当前电影帧重建空间形状和颜色。
人物左手、腰线和右裙摆的投影在新镜头下出现偏差；后续姿态修正仍须保持脚部安全间隙和穿门连续性。
人物脸型、发丝、握门细节，以及墙面污迹、藤叶贴合和水面反射仍需精修。
网页几何、镜头、脚本和资源可核验，但浏览器连接超时，实际渲染与交互仍待复测。
